stories.title: Ibero-American International Film Festival kicks off in Riyadh

en.title: Ibero-American International Film Festival kicks off in Riyadh
en.summary: The fifth Ibero-American International Film Festival began in Riyadh, showcasing cinema from 13 countries including Brazil, Spain, Mexico, and Portugal. The event runs until October 8 at the Embassy of India auditorium.

stories.title: Hegra Highlights Status as Saudi Arabia’s First UNESCO World Heritage Site

en.title: Hegra Highlights Status as Saudi Arabia's First UNESCO World Heritage Site
en.summary: Hegra is recognized as Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site.

stories.title: Red Sea International Film Festival postpones sixth edition to late 2027

en.title: Red Sea International Film Festival postpones sixth edition to late 2027
en.summary: The Red Sea International Film Festival's sixth edition has been postponed to the fourth quarter of 2027. The foundation will continue year-round activities and introduce new programs beginning in November 2026.

stories.title: Saudi crown prince launches Ceer’s first EVs to boost Kingdom’s automotive industry

en.title: Saudi crown prince launches Ceer's first EVs to boost Kingdom's automotive industry
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman launched Ceer's first electric vehicles called Exobot to advance the Kingdom's automotive sector and support Vision 2030 goals.

stories.title: Crown Prince launches CEER’s first electric vehicles, EXOBOT sedan and SUV

en.title: Crown Prince launches CEER's first electric vehicles, EXOBOT sedan and SUV
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman launched EXOBOT, the first electric vehicles from CEER, the kingdom's national automotive company. The launch represents progress in developing Saudi Arabia's automotive industry and industrial base.

stories.title: WAMY Commends Saudi Arabia’s Efforts to Support Peace, Security, Stability

en.title: WAMY Commends Saudi Arabia's Efforts to Support Peace, Security, Stability
en.summary: WAMY has praised Saudi Arabia's efforts in supporting peace, security, and stability.

stories.title: Crown Prince Launches CEER's Flagship Vehicles

en.title: Crown Prince Launches CEER's Flagship Vehicles
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince has launched CEER's flagship vehicles, marking a significant development for the kingdom's national automotive company.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea International Film Festival postponed until 2027

en.title: Saudi Arabia's Red Sea International Film Festival postponed until 2027
en.summary: The Red Sea International Film Festival in Jeddah has been postponed to the fourth quarter of 2027 following a comprehensive review of logistical requirements for hosting the international event.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Israeli Official, Settlers’ Storming of Al-Aqsa Courtyards

en.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Israeli Official, Settlers' Storming of Al-Aqsa Courtyards
en.summary: Saudi Arabia issued a condemnation regarding Israeli officials and settlers entering Al-Aqsa courtyards.

stories.title: Dina Ahmed makes history with Saudi Arabia’s first women’s Asian Games medal

en.title: Dina Ahmed makes history with Saudi Arabia's first women's Asian Games medal
en.summary: Saudi karate athlete Dina Ahmed won bronze at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, becoming the first Saudi woman to earn a medal at the Games. She achieved the victory by overcoming a 3-0 deficit against Nepal's Aruka Gurung in the 68 kg competition.

stories.title: Saudi basalt recognized as Global Heritage Stone in Kingdom first

en.title: Saudi basalt recognized as Global Heritage Stone in Kingdom first
en.summary: The International Union of Geological Sciences designated basalt rocks from Saudi Arabia's harrats as Global Heritage Stones, marking the first such recognition for the Kingdom. The Saudi Geological Survey documented the geological, historical, and cultural significance of these rocks.

stories.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia

en.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Multiple Arab nations and Islamic organizations condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including a ballistic missile attempt on Riyadh and strikes on civilian areas. Yemen, Kuwait, Egypt, Bahrain, Lebanon, and Jordan issued statements expressing solidarity with Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: ‎MENA’s Market Leaders Connect with Global and Regional Capital at EFG Hermes’ 12th Annual London Investor Conference

en.title: MENA's Market Leaders Connect with Global and Regional Capital at EFG Hermes' 12th Annual London Investor Conference
en.summary: EFG Hermes held its 12th annual London Investor Conference from September 21-24, 2026, at Emirates Stadium, bringing together prominent Middle Eastern and North African companies and global institutional investors for investment discussions.

stories.title: ‎Al Battal Factory outlines measures to address accumulated losses

en.title: Al Battal Factory outlines measures to address accumulated losses
en.summary: Al Battal Factory for Chemical Industries announced a plan to address accumulated losses totaling 74.29% of its capital through insurance compensation collection and shareholder equity restructuring. The board approved measures intended to gradually improve financial performance.

stories.title: ‎EFG Hermes Secures Top Corporate Access and Research Rankings in 2026 Extel Emerging EMEA Survey

en.title: EFG Hermes Secures Top Corporate Access and Research Rankings in 2026 Extel Emerging EMEA Survey
en.summary: EFG Hermes, a leading Middle East and North Africa investment bank, ranked first in the Corporate Access Conference category for the second consecutive year in the 2026 Extel Emerging EMEA Research Survey. The bank's research division also achieved top rankings across key sectors.

en.title: SHL renews SAR 200M facilities with SAIB
en.summary: SHL Finance Co. renewed a Shariah-compliant credit facility agreement with The Saudi Investment Bank for SAR 200 million with a five-year term. The financing will support the company's expansion and increase sales volume through customer financing.

stories.title: ‎Southern Cement partially hands over new Jazan production line

en.title: Southern Cement partially hands over new Jazan production line
en.summary: Southern Province Cement Co. partially accepted its new production line at the Jazan Cement Plant as part of the project completion process. The entire facility is expected to commence commercial operations before the end of 2026.
